scope: Independent review of the implementation while room routes and enquiry form were still being completed. No frontend edits made by reviewer.
environment: Python Playwright, fresh headless Microsoft Edge contexts, device scale factor 1, CSS widths 390 and 1440, viewport height 900, local server http://127.0.0.1:3080.

findings.title: Home destination links target missing anchors
findings.evidence: app/page.tsx links to /varanasi#river, #temple and #aarti, while captured Varanasi page contained no elements with those ids. The link promise is a specific chapter, but browser cannot target it.
findings.suggested_fix: Add river, temple and aarti IDs to their destination chapter elements.

findings.title: Inactive room tabs reference absent panels
findings.evidence: Home DOM reports aria-controls room-panel-1 and room-panel-2 but only room-panel-0 exists when Deluxe is selected. Verified at 390 and 1440 CSS pixels. Click and arrow-key selection otherwise works.
findings.suggested_fix: Point all tabs at a stable single tabpanel id and update its aria-labelledby, or render all tabpanels and hide inactive panels.

findings.title: Mobile hero image is undersized for its cover crop
findings.evidence: At 390x900 CSS pixels with deviceScaleFactor 1, hero image currentSrc selected Next image width=640 while container is 390x760. A 3:2 landscape image covering a 760px-tall frame needs approximately 1140px source width. Screenshot home-390-top.png shows softened detail.
findings.suggested_fix: Use a mobile sizes value that accounts for the tall cover crop or provide a dedicated mobile crop.

findings.title: Floating WhatsApp action covers hero caption at desktop height
findings.evidence: home-1440-top.png shows the bottom-right Life along the Ganges caption partly behind the fixed WhatsApp CTA at 1440x900.
findings.suggested_fix: Reserve right or bottom clearance for the floating CTA.

passes: Home, Gallery, Varanasi, Contact and Privacy routes each returned 200 at both widths.
All 10 page/viewport combinations had body.scrollWidth equal to documentElement.clientWidth and no element overflow detected.
No browser pageerror events were captured.
Visible images decoded on all five pages; the unloaded room-tea image on mobile is intentionally display:none, so it is not a visible broken image.
Home room tabs display the correct genuine double, twin and family photographs; each link updates to the corresponding room slug.
Arrow-right moves selected tab and focus together.
Mobile menu opens at the full 390px width, locks background scrolling, focuses close, closes on Escape and restores the trigger focus.
Desktop hamburger is hidden while desktop navigation remains visible.
Gallery filters show 4 Hotel, 6 Rooms and 2 Dining photographs. Lightbox opens, advances with arrow keys, closes with Escape and restores opener focus.
Each page has one H1 and page title lengths of 51 to 53 characters.
Hotel imagery accurately represents the property and room arrangements. Destination imagery is identified as Varanasi rather than a room view.
Temple image and credit correctly reference Pradum Shukla under CC BY 4.0. Unsplash destination credits match manifest. Sunrise wording for ARTO SURAJ follows the photographer's explicit description.
limitations: Room routes and the final enquiry form were being implemented during this review and were not assessed.
This is a functional and visual accessibility spot-check, not a formal WCAG conformance audit.
No WhatsApp messages or hotel communications were sent.
